description: This file defines the `Screen` class within the `OrangeHRM\Installer\Util\V1\Dto` namespace. The class models a UI screen with properties like name, module, URL, permissions, and an optional menu configurator. It includes a constructor, a factory method for creation from an array, and getter methods for all properties.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Models a UI screen with properties such as name, module, URL, permissions, and an optional menu configurator. Provides methods for instantiation from array data and for retrieving property values.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a `Screen` object with specified name, module, URL, permissions, and optional menu configurator.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Factory method to create a `Screen` instance from a name and an associative array containing 'permissions', 'module', 'url', and optional 'menuConfigurator'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with the screen.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the screen.

methods.name: getMenuConfigurator
methods.description: Returns the optional menu configurator string.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the array of `DataGroupPermission` objects associated with the screen.
